title: Remove admin restriction on product uploads

requirements.summary: Remove client-side admin checks from ProductManagement to allow any authenticated user to upload products
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated users can access the product upload form
Product upload dialog opens successfully for any authenticated user
No client-side validation blocks authenticated users from submitting products

file_operations.description: Remove or relax any client-side admin-only checks that prevent authenticated non-admin users from accessing the product upload form and submitting products. Ensure the component checks for authentication (either custom session token or Internet Identity) but does not require admin role. Update error messages to reflect the new 'authenticated user' requirement instead of 'admin-only'. The backend authorization logic (REQ-1) will handle the actual permission enforcement.

Review and update the addProduct mutation to ensure it does not include client-side admin role checks. The mutation should allow any authenticated user to call the backend addProduct method. Remove any admin permission validations from the mutation's onMutate or other lifecycle hooks. The backend will enforce the authentication requirement as specified in REQ-1.
